apparatus: Periodic exclusion ring, even L, fixed N=L/2 canonical stationary initial ensemble; successful right/left jumps at rates D exp(+/-E/L); Q_t=total signed successful jumps over all bonds/L; psi=lim_L L lim_t log E exp(lambda Q_t)/t in the fixed microscopic clock.
api: Model().fit(records) returns self and stores diffusivity; predict(experiments) returns a finite numpy array with one raw SCGF per {field,bias} input.

calibration.fit: exact weighted least squares through origin, clipped to[.8,1.2]

gold: The two distinguishing groups use the six raw selected grid256 D=1 values from the reviewed domain report, scaled exactly by D. Exact limits use D*lambda*(lambda+2E)/4.
controls: Elliptic scalar physical oracle and completed homogeneous-profile shortcut share the exact calibration fit. Public starter uses the homogeneous predictor with fit unfinished.
check_order: Write this plan before calibration generation.
Create self-contained task, completed shortcut, private independent grid reference and retained scientific provenance.
Generate the192 observations once with the fixed seed/sigma; copy identical bytes to public and private calibration.
Validate source transfer and local oracle/shortcut metrics against the frozen independent gold.
Reproduce the six grid references once from the self-contained packaged code at128/256 and three fixed seeds, with the reviewed polishing.
Evaluate all256 fixed-seed noisy fits and all hidden groups for both completed controls; retain every realization.
Run isolated local public/private pytest controls and retain their complete logs.
Write AUTHOR/ASSESSMENT with results and limitations; root and separate teammate review before freeze/Docker controls.
retention: Every validation invocation writes a fresh timestamped report and logs, including exceptions/failures. Ordinary validation reads existing data. Only explicit --regenerate regenerates identical predeclared data; no outcome-based seed, sigma or case change.
